title: Golden Gamble
description: Golden Gamble Every golden apple you eat is now a gamble.
body:
Golden Gamble

Every golden apple you eat is now a gamble. Eat one and roll the dice:

30% chance: bad luck (hunger + weakness)
30% chance: nothing much, just a small heal
30% chance: good luck (strength + speed buff)
10% chance: JACKPOT — 5 diamonds, absorption, and strength, announced to the whole server
100% vanilla commands — no blocks destroyed, nothing that breaks your world. Safe for survival, creative, and multiplayer servers.

Requirements: Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.5+, no mods/plugins needed.
